articles.title: The Plan: At 44 West Eighth Street, the Goal Is a ‘Wonderful Visual Cacophony’
articles.narrative: T30 Capital and InWorkshop are developing 44 West Eighth Street, a new five-unit condominium project in Manhattan's Greenwich Village. The building will feature a unique facade made from handmade Danish Petersen brick, with each brick bearing the thumbprints of its maker, and partially hand-pressed and extruded terra cotta. The design emphasizes integrating exterior materials into the interior, with crushed brick remnants used in the lobby flooring. The project aims to offer exceptionally spacious condominiums, with full-floor homes starting at $9.75 million and a duplex penthouse potentially priced up to $20 million.

data_points.address: 44 West Eighth Street, New York City, NY
data_points.completion: late spring or early summer of 2027
data_points.notable_features: Exterior facade made from handmade Danish Petersen brick and partially hand-pressed and extruded terra cotta; each residence has a distinct layout, including full-floor homes and a duplex penthouse; amenities include a private rooftop terrace for the penthouse, a gym with a sauna, and storage rooms for each unit.
data_points.project_notes: Construction expected to be substantially completed late 2026 or early 2027.

articles.title: Tax-Exempt Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities Are Having a Moment
articles.narrative: The tax-exempt commercial mortgage-backed securities (CMBS) market is gaining traction as a financing mechanism for affordable housing in the U.S., driven by new federal rules and increased attention from ratings agencies and major banks. This structure offers lower capital costs compared to traditional taxable CMBS or agency-backed affordable housing loans, making it attractive to investors, especially in a higher interest rate environment. The market's evolution is supported by the strong credit performance of affordable housing and the ability to attract a broader institutional investor base, leading to increased demand and liquidity for these securitized offerings.

articles.title: Dermatology Chain LaserAway Adds 15th NYC Location on the Upper East Side
articles.narrative: LaserAway, a provider of dermatology and body wellness services, has signed a 10-year lease for 1,800 square feet at 242 East 86th Street in Manhattan's Upper East Side. This marks the company's 15th location in New York City, expanding its presence in a key urban market. The asking rent for the ground-floor space was $165 per square foot.

data_points.address: 242 East 86th Street, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Ground floor retail space in a 55,158-square-foot mixed-use property.

articles.title: Nuveen Green Capital Closes $173M C-PACE Loan on Miami-Area Condos Project
articles.narrative: Nuveen Green Capital has provided a $172.5 million C-PACE loan to Shoma Group for the development of its Shoma Bay mixed-use condominium project in North Bay Village, FL. This transaction is significant as Nuveen Green Capital is the sole debt provider in the capital stack, making it one of Florida's largest C-PACE-financed projects. The development will feature 333 condo units and retail space, including a large supermarket, and is expected to contribute to the ongoing evolution of North Bay Village as a dynamic waterfront community.

data_points.address: 1850 John F. Kennedy Causeway, North Bay Village, FL
data_points.notable_features: Waterfront project with a rooftop pool deck, wellness spa, two-story fitness center, padel court, and coworking spaces.
data_points.project_notes: The C-PACE loan is the sole debt provider in the capital stack, supplemented by condo sales deposits and equity.

articles.title: Related Ross Buys Land for Major Mixed-Use Dev in Florida
articles.narrative: Related Ross, led by Stephen Ross, has acquired a 32-acre parcel in Wellington, FL, for $28.3 million to develop Village Landing, a significant mixed-use project. The development will feature a 180-room hotel and over 300,000 square feet of retail, office, and restaurant space, designed to enhance the local community with everyday amenities and experiences. Construction is slated to begin in the fall, with Starwood Property Trust providing a $29.1 million loan for the acquisition and development.

data_points.notable_features: Open-air mixed-use development with six connecting plazas, located in an area renowned for its equestrian scene.
data_points.project_notes: The acquired 32-acre parcel is part of a larger 71-acre site within the Acme Improvement District. An additional 44-acre western portion of the site will be developed into a private grade school by ElevateED, with that land sale expected to close in October.

articles.title: Altana Signs 62,309 SF Office Lease at The PENN District in Midtown Manhattan
articles.narrative: Altana, a provider of AI-driven trade and supply chain management solutions, has signed a 10-year lease for 62,309 square feet of office space at The PENN District in Midtown Manhattan. The company will establish its new headquarters on the entire 21st floor of PENN 2, a component of Vornado Realty Trust's 4.4 million-square-foot development.

articles.title: Cushman & Wakefield Arranges $72M Refinancing for Two Adjacent Shopping Centers in Sandy Springs, Georgia
articles.narrative: Cushman & Wakefield has arranged a $72 million floating-rate refinancing loan for Jamestown LP, covering two adjacent retail centers in Sandy Springs, Georgia. The properties, Parkside Shops and Hammond Exchange, total over 340,000 square feet and are anchored by a prominent grocery store. The financing was secured through accounts managed by KKR.

data_points.notable_features: Anchored by a 49,506-square-foot Whole Foods Market.

articles.title: RSA Properties to Develop 130,000 SF Industrial Facility for Camco Chemical in Northern Kentucky
articles.narrative: RSA Properties LLC is developing a 130,000-square-foot build-to-suit warehouse and distribution center for Camco Chemical in Independence, KY. The new facility will be located within Camco Chemical's existing campus on Holton Drive, on a site previously occupied by an IRS facility. Furlong Building is serving as the general contractor for the project.

data_points.notable_features: Build-to-suit facility within an existing campus.
data_points.project_notes: Site previously housed an IRS facility.

articles.title: Ram Realty Delivers 310-Unit Apartment Community in Durham
articles.narrative: Ram Realty Advisors has completed Wye Junction, a 310-unit apartment community in Durham, NC. The project involved the adaptive reuse of the former Erwin Oil site, incorporating historical elements like repurposed oil tankers and train trestles into its design. The community also includes over 7,000 square feet of retail space and various amenities.

data_points.notable_features: Adaptive reuse of a former oil distribution facility, incorporating repurposed oil tankers and train trestles; includes over 7,000 square feet of retail space, a pedestrian plaza, and rooftop amenities.
data_points.project_notes: Former Erwin Oil site dating back to 1937.

articles.title: Corvant Signs 113,865 SF Industrial Lease in Douglasville, Georgia
articles.narrative: Corvant, an HVAC and mechanical plumbing manufacturer, has signed a full-building lease for 113,865 square feet at LogistiCenter at Bright Star in Douglasville, GA. The industrial facility, recently delivered by landlord Dermody, offers modern features including 32-foot clear heights and ESFR fire protection. The lease was facilitated by Hughes Commercial Real Estate representing the landlord and The Realty Group representing the tenant.

data_points.notable_features: Rear-load facility with 32-foot clear heights, a 60-foot speed bay, 28 dock-high doors, two drive-in doors, approximately 90 automobile parking spaces, and ESFR fire protection.

articles.title: Partners Capital closes sale of 115,512-square-foot retail center in Austin
articles.narrative: Partners Capital has completed the sale of Oak Hill Plaza, a 115,512-square-foot retail center located in Austin, Texas. The property, situated at a prominent intersection in Southwest Austin, was originally acquired by Partners Capital in August 2021. This disposition represents the third property sale from Partners Capital's Opportunity Fund IV investment vehicle.

data_points.notable_features: Located at the intersection of US Highway 290 West and Texas State Highway 71, a heavily traveled retail corridor known as the "Oak Hill Y."
data_points.project_notes: Partners Capital originally acquired the property in August 2021.

articles.title: Signs of life in Chicago’s office market? Yes, but not everywhere
articles.narrative: Chicago's office market is experiencing a "flight-to-quality" trend, with tenants, especially large corporate occupiers and professional services firms, gravitating towards top-tier buildings in prime locations. This is evident in the Central Business District's continued momentum through August, with trophy properties accounting for a significant portion of new leasing activity. The West Loop, Fulton Market, and River North submarkets are leading in leasing volume and average new lease sizes, indicating strong demand for high-quality, amenitized spaces that support modern workplace strategies.

articles.title: Knighthead Funding provides $32 million refinance loan for 62-unit multifamily community in Glenview
articles.narrative: Knighthead Funding has provided a $32 million refinancing loan to The Drake Group for Cerca, a newly constructed 62-unit Class-A multifamily community in downtown Glenview, IL. The loan refinances a previous construction facility and provides proceeds to pay off the property's preferred equity investor. This transaction highlights the continued demand for high-quality multifamily assets in supply-constrained markets with strong fundamentals, particularly in affluent suburban areas with excellent transit access.

data_points.notable_features: Transit-oriented development with high-end amenities including fitness rooms, private dining, conference rooms, amenity deck, dog spa, and grilling stations. Includes ground-floor retail space.
data_points.project_notes: Loan refinances a previous construction facility and pays off a preferred equity investor.

articles.title: Logistics Property Company closes 217,758-square-foot industrial lease at Missouri City’s CityPark Logistics Center
articles.narrative: Logistics Property Company has secured a 217,758-square-foot build-to-suit industrial lease with Standex GRID / Amran Instrument Transformers at CityPark Logistics Center in Missouri City, TX. The new facility, currently under construction and expected to complete in Q2 2027, will serve as a warehouse and manufacturing plant, consolidating the tenant's existing Texas operations into its largest North American location. The project benefits from its strategic Southwest Houston location with direct access to Beltway 8, proximity to Highway 90, and a strong local workforce, which were key factors in its selection.

data_points.notable_features: Cross-dock building with 32-foot clear height, ample car and trailer parking, direct access to Beltway 8, proximity to Highway 90.
data_points.project_notes: Build-to-suit warehouse and manufacturing facility. Consolidates five Houston-area locations for the tenant.

articles.title: Dallas Multifamily 2026 Panelists Cautious, Hopeful About Industry Future
articles.narrative: A panel of multifamily experts at the Connect Texas Multifamily Dallas event discussed the competitive Dallas market, emphasizing the importance of operational execution and differentiation beyond standard amenities. While acknowledging near-term operational pressures due to a significant supply wave, panelists expressed optimism for improvement as the market works through overbuilding, with some developers exploring opportunities in secondary Texas cities.

articles.title: Midtown Office Tower Scores Leases Totaling 182K SF
articles.narrative: Three companies have signed new leases totaling over 182,000 square feet at 1411 Broadway, a Midtown office tower owned by The Swig Company. The transactions include a software company doubling its footprint and relocating its headquarters, a South Korean beauty group moving its headquarters, and an existing subtenant converting to a direct lease. These deals follow a significant $100 million renovation of the property, which is expected to boost occupancy to 90% by year-end.

data_points.notable_features: The building recently underwent a $100 million renovation, including a new entrance, facade, and renovated plaza, with a new rooftop amenity space opening in early 2028.

articles.title: Former Factory to Receive New Life as Affordable Homes in Upstate NY
articles.narrative: A former factory in Tupper Lake, NY, is being redeveloped into an 80-unit affordable housing property with additional commercial space. The $46 million project, a collaboration between Housing Visions, Lahinch Group, and Braxton Capital, will transform the long-vacant Oval Wood Dish Factory into modern, all-electric apartments for households earning up to 90% of the Area Median Income. This development is part of Governor Hochul's broader $25 billion Housing Plan aimed at creating or preserving 100,000 affordable homes across New York.

data_points.notable_features: All-electric building utilizing cold-climate heat pump technology for heating and cooling, and a whole-building ventilation system.
data_points.project_notes: Residences are affordable to households earning up to 90% of the Area Median Income. Project is part of Governor Hochul’s $25 billion Housing Plan.

articles.title: Colliers Completes Sale of Healthcare Center in Twin Cities Metro
articles.narrative: Colliers facilitated the sale of Eagan Medical Center, a 43,419-square-foot outpatient facility in Eagan, Minnesota. The seller, Tareen Development Partners, had acquired the property in December 2024 and executed a value-add strategy by rebranding it, making targeted improvements, and enhancing leasing activity to create a specialty healthcare destination. This strategy successfully attracted significant investor interest, leading to the recent transaction.

data_points.notable_features: Anchored by MNGI Digestive Health, Minnesota Urology, and Tareen Dermatology, with ample surface and underground parking. Conveniently located near Interstates 35E and 494.
data_points.project_notes: Previously known as Town Centre Plaza, acquired by Tareen Development Partners in December 2024 for a value-add initiative.

articles.title: Essex Realty Group Brokers Sale of 12-Unit MF in Tinley Park
articles.narrative: Essex Realty Group brokered the sale of a 12-unit multifamily property in Tinley Park, Illinois, for $1.51 million. The property, which had been under the same ownership since 2001, was acquired by an out-of-state investor looking to expand their Chicago-area portfolio. The buyer plans to implement a value-add strategy by renovating the remaining ten units and increasing rents to market rates, capitalizing on the strong investor demand for such assets in Chicago's suburban multifamily market.

data_points.notable_features: Property consists of ten two-bedroom, one-bathroom units and two one-bedroom, one-bathroom units; two units are fully renovated, ten are in standard condition.
data_points.project_notes: The property was owned by the same seller since 2001. The buyer plans to renovate the remaining units and push rents to market levels.

articles.market_intelligence: There is strong investor appetite for value-add multifamily assets in Chicago's suburban markets.

articles.title: Bluerock Affiliate Acquires Sunnyvale Office Hub For $330.7M
articles.narrative: An affiliate of Bluerock acquired an office hub in Sunnyvale, CA for $330.7 million. The transaction included a 20-year leaseback agreement with the seller, indicating continued confidence in the Bay Area office market.

data_points.project_notes: Includes a 20-year leaseback agreement with the seller.

articles.title: CRE's Clearance Rack Is Empty, Leaving Landlords To Create Their Own Value
articles.narrative: Commercial real estate analysts are observing a market where distressed assets, often referred to as the 'clearance rack,' are no longer readily available. This scarcity is prompting landlords to proactively enhance the value of their properties through strategic management and improvements, rather than relying on opportunistic acquisitions of undervalued assets. The current market environment emphasizes the importance of net operating income as the primary driver for asset appreciation.

articles.title: Developer To Pay Biscayne 21 Holdouts $50M After Lengthy Legal Battle
articles.narrative: A developer has agreed to pay $50 million to the remaining holdout owners at the Biscayne 21 condominium, resolving a protracted legal dispute. This settlement clears the path for the demolition of the existing building and the construction of new luxury condominium towers, which are expected to carry Marriott branding. The resolution marks a significant step forward for the long-stalled redevelopment project.

data_points.notable_features: New luxury condominium towers are expected to carry Marriott branding.
data_points.project_notes: Settlement resolves a lengthy legal battle with holdout owners, paving the way for demolition and redevelopment.

articles.title: Lenders Warm Up, Lawmakers Step In: Modular Construction Picks Up In SoCal
articles.narrative: Modular construction is gaining traction in Southern California, with developers reporting reduced obstacles due to increasing support from lenders and favorable legislative changes. This shift indicates a growing acceptance and integration of modular building methods within the region's real estate development landscape.

articles.title: Ares And Scion's Student Housing JV Acquires 4 Communities For $435M
articles.narrative: A joint venture between Ares Management and Scion has acquired four student housing communities totaling 2,316 beds for $435 million. This acquisition expands their student housing portfolio, particularly within the Sun Belt region, demonstrating continued investment in this growing market segment.
